profiles.name: Grove RT890E
profiles.setup: Mode B; 22,000 lb counterweight; full 24 ft outrigger spread; 360° main-boom chart
profiles.deductionNote: Auxiliary boom nose: 133 lb (page 21). No stowed-jib deduction in this guide.

profiles.name: Terex RT175
profiles.setup: 4-section boom; 15,200 lb total counterweight; full outriggers; 360°; LMI code 04
profiles.deductionNote: No 150 lb auxiliary-head add-back used. Hook/block/slings must be included in the entered handling weight (page 14).

profiles.name: Grove RT635C
profiles.deductionNote: Conservative 641 lb stowed swingaway plus 143 lb auxiliary head deduction (page 6). 58 ft column requires inner-mid extended, outer-mid and fly retracted.

profiles.name: National 1400H
profiles.setup: Series 14127H, 127 ft boom; full 24 ft 6 in span; factory-approved truck; 360° only with front stabilizer deployed
profiles.deductionNote: Published capacities used without the no-stowed-jib add-backs. Front stabilizer required for forward lifts (page 5).

profiles.name: Altec AC25-95B
profiles.setup: 95 ft main boom; full 18 ft 6 in main/auxiliary outriggers; 360° only with front bumper outrigger deployed
profiles.deductionNote: Stowed-jib deduction applied per boom length: 825 / 550 / 425 / 350 / 300 / 250 lb. Correct reeving/hoist selection required. Chart is 95 ft, despite the catalog spec saying 105 ft.

excluded.name: Terex RT40
excluded.reason: The linked PDF is labelled Voltas VRT40, not Terex RT40. A matching unit chart is required before automatic selection.
